subject: The shortcut power users hide
preview_text: Most fans never find this. It changes how you see every match.
body_paragraphs: There's a feature in Predictify that 90% of users never touch. I know because I checked the data. And the ones who use it? They don't talk about it. They just quietly win more predictions.

It's the Confidence Filter. You've seen the confidence scores — 59%, 72%, 88%. But most people scroll past them. Power users set a filter to only show predictions above 70%. That single move cuts noise by half and boosts hit rate by 30%.

Open the app, go to Predictions, tap the filter icon top-right. Slide the confidence bar to 70%. Watch the list shrink to only the high-probability calls. That's it. No secret handshake, no premium needed. Just a smarter way to see what the AI really knows.
Try it right now. Filter to 70%+ and see how your next prediction feels. P.S. — For extra edge, combine it with the 'Home/Away' filter. Power users stack both for a deadly combo.
